entries.299178b0da92c01f: A certified broadcasting holding company headquartered in Sawara Ward, Fukuoka City, which forms a group with 11 consolidated subsidiaries and three affiliates. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 701, and the company is listed on the Fukuoka Stock Exchange.
entries.65189a01b201199d: A segment whose main business is the sale of television and radio programs and spot CM. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,464 million; the revenue breakdown was ¥13,380 million from TV broadcasting, ¥1,029 million from radio broadcasting and ¥1,049 million from others. Consolidated subsidiary RKB Mainichi Broadcasting Corporation handles broadcasting, and RKB CINC Co., Ltd. handles part of program production, industrial and public relations film production, and the dispatch of program production staff and clerical workers. Event planning and production are also included in this segment.
entries.6ab668b1904b0ce5: This segment engages in e-commerce and land-based salmon aquaculture, and was newly established in the fiscal year ended March 2026. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,047 million. Through consolidated subsidiaries including Fun Standard Co., Ltd., it mainly runs e-commerce of original planned products, and Munakata Land Aquaculture Co., Ltd. conducts land-based salmon aquaculture.

entries.e320efea154a92b2: A certified broadcasting holding company based in Fukuoka that, with television and radio broadcasting at its core, operates businesses including system development, real estate and e-commerce.
entries.e747f76625899e6a: This segment develops, sells and maintains systems (software), and provides cloud and security services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,965 million. Through its consolidated subsidiary BCC Co., Ltd., it supports government and municipal system standardization and migration to government cloud, updates electronic medical records and medical administration systems at medical institutions, provides security services for private companies, and supports DX in retail stores.
entries.ffb32b7799e330e5: This segment leases real estate, operates parking facilities, and conducts solar power generation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,066 million. The company leases land and part of its broadcasting building, while its consolidated subsidiary RKB Kohatsu Co., Ltd. manages the broadcasting building and conducts solar power generation, and also operates parking facilities.
